messages.content: I'm Meera, a data analyst at Finlytics. My manager is Karan.
Hi Meera! Happy to help with your analytics work at Finlytics.
Our main dashboard project is code-named ORION-7.
Got it, ORION-7 is your main dashboard project.
For ORION-7 we're moving the dashboards from Tableau to Power BI.
Understood, ORION-7 is migrating from Tableau to Power BI.
Karan asked me to finish the ORION-7 migration by Nov 15.
Noted, the ORION-7 migration deadline is Nov 15.

distractor_sessions: My friend Divya at DataCorp is moving her dashboards to Looker by Dec 1.
Good luck to Divya with the Looker migration.
Karan's birthday is on Nov 3, any gift ideas?
A nice notebook, a plant, or a book he'd enjoy.
Another team runs a project called ORION-3 that stays on Tableau.
Got it, ORION-3 is a separate project that stays on Tableau.
